I know the author stopped supporting this mod, I'm still using it because it's working in my world. It was making my game crash during the Moonstorm event though.
This fix worked for me:
1. Go to workshop-375850593 folder and create a backup copy of modmain.lua
2. Edit the modmain.lua file to include this (I added it at line 69):
-- Fix for moonstorm crash - ensure isexternallyinsulated exists properly
AddComponentPostInit("inventory", function(self)
if self.isexternallyinsulated == nil then
-- Create a simple object that mimics the expected interface
self.isexternallyinsulated = {
Get = function() return false end  -- Return false = not insulated
}
end
end)
3. Save the file, reload the game, re-attempt.

The difference is, it doesn't ever destroy items lying on the ground, and it doesn't clean/stack things at intervals, but instead stacks items when they are dropped/spawned next to similar items. It can also do this during server start up, so if a bunch of rocks spawn next to each other, they will be stacked.

It makes no sence in tf2 to have teleports that go both ways, as you have no buisness comming back to spawn. It is not the case here. And either way you can only craft 2 teleports if you want them to go both ways.

Despite being incredibly well made, Engineer is actually a pretty terrible character, at least with default settings, which are the only settings I ever use on charcater mods, to play as the devs see fit.

Or rather it would, if Engi didn't had a negative multiplayer, making the damage equivalent to Lucy (comedically awful). I know that his main downside is that he is bad at hand combat, but considering that an axe deals more damage and costs 1 flint, I think wrench should have 34 damage (27.5 for engi). 错误描述
当“小鸟游星野”模组（ID: 3398290914）的“尼卢火”建筑击杀“致命亮茄”（`lunarthrall_plant`）时，游戏崩溃。

`[string "../mods/workshop-3235319974/scripts/main/co..."]:14: attempt to index local 'new' (a nil value)`
问题分析
- 【登仙】模组在`spawnitem`函数中试图生成物品`xd_lingshi1`，但局部变量`new`为`nil`，导致索引失败。
- 此错误发生在“致命亮茄”死亡掉落时，可能因【登仙】接管掉落逻辑时与其他模组（小鸟游星野）产生冲突，或未正确处理某些情况。
建议修复方向
检查`components.lua`中`spawnitem`函数对`new`变量的初始化与使用，确保在`new`为`nil`时有容错处理（如直接返回或跳过）。同时排查`xd_lingshi1`的生成条件是否完整。

用小鸟游玩到月亮线后期，一旦尼炉火杀死亮茄游戏直接崩：
原因:崩溃发生于Mod"【登仙】"的
脚本"components.lua"。自动诊断
将其标记为"High-Risk"，表明它是最
直接的嫌疑。详细堆栈追踪显示，在
执行"DropLoot"(掉落战利品）操作
时，代码尝试访问一个局部变量
"new"，但该变量的值为"nil"，这不
符合预期。根本原因是该Mod在处理
“致命亮茄”的掉落逻辑时，可能由于
与“小鸟游星野”Mod在战利品掉落机
制上的代码冲突，导致在尝试实例化

content_text:
这个MOD玩起来怪怪的，又好玩又难受，尤其是用其他MOD人物的时候。
问题应该在数值，前期玩得难受，中后期又简单甚至无聊。
能不能设置几个可选难度如：凡界、灵界、仙界。
凡界难度数值更保守：
升小境界加５-10点三维，保证化神以下三维不超过５００
升大境界解锁相应的技能和科技，同时提升少许攻击或减伤（攻击倍数最好别超过３，常态伤害膨胀很影响体验，叠BUFF爆发就随便）
对应的原版生物也就不需要强化太多。
普通强化生物加５-15点“属性伤害/抵抗”，有额外机制的（如催眠、阴影触手等）则算二次强化（贴图调大当精英怪）。
未被强化的原版生物保留，与强化生物共存混居，形成少数强化怪、精英怪与多数普通怪混合的多样化生态群落。
强化生物额外掉落灵石等专属物品，未强化生物则维持原版掉落。

这个mod我基本就是靠二亚的绿宝石结晶配合解封主的分解无限刷材料，我觉得还蛮好玩的。遇到的几个问题是：1.打帝王蟹不爆那个装备，不论帝王蟹是不是装了珍珠，我刷了十几个boss一个也不出，最后靠代码拿了一个。2.给二亚的结晶装了宝石以后，那个buff是跟随人的，不论脱不脱结晶。例如装了紫宝石以后，就算脱了装备还是0san，我甚至把结晶扔在地上给宝石，人物也会吃到永久buff。我也测试了给结晶一个新的宝石是会覆盖原来的buff，但是依然是绑定在人物身上，目前解决方案是下线再上线，这样能让buff正常跟着结晶走。
说实话，玩了不少人物mod，这个算发育逻辑清晰，功能齐全且bug很少的大型人物模组了，感恩~

content_text:
geodrop is build on an RPC that basically lets it say "put this item from my hand in exactly position x, y, z", and the DST server will do that. There's no equivalent RPC for placing statues (they are a "worn" item in the back slot rather than an item you "hold" in your hand). There's not even an RPC to say "move my character to position X, Y, Z. So, mods like Statue Placement that serve this purpose are forced to try and implement the positioning client-side, but it's tricky to get it just right.
Anyway, all that to say that it's not something geodrop can support. Would recommend one of the other mods specifically built for placing statues.

content_text:
geodrop is build on an RPC that basically lets it say "put this item from my hand in exactly position x, y, z", and the DST server will do that. There's no equivalent RPC for placing statues (they are a "worn" item in the back slot rather than an item you "hold" in your hand). There's not even an RPC to say "move my character to position X, Y, Z. So, mods like Statue Placement that serve this purpose are forced to try and implement the positioning client-side, but it's tricky to get it just right.
Anyway, all that to say that it's not something geodrop can support. Would recommend one of the other mods specifically built for placing statues.

content_text:
hi Electroely, just wanted to report a behavior that I've seen occasionally over the years of using this mod, and which I noticed happening again yesterday - when you run out of one or more ingredients for a recipe you've been repeating, if you have excess of one of the remaining ingredients available, the Crock Pot will fill out the rest of the slots using that remaining ingredient.
An example of this is making Meaty Stews with 1 Meat, 1 Monster Meat, and 2 Morsels. When you run out of Morsels, if you have excess Monster Meat in your inventory or Ice/Salt Box containing the ingredients, Crock Pot Repeater will fill the remaining two slots in the Crock Pot (which should have had Morsels) with Monster Meat, resulting in Monster Lasagna.
